title: Black Lace Knit & Plaid Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy black hair stands against a warm off-white backdrop. She wears a black ribbed knit long-sleeve top with a sheer lace yoke and a lace neck tie, layered over a low-rise black belt with a silver western buckle. Below, a dark green and navy plaid pleated mini skirt with sheer black tulle trim. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of black, forest green, and soft ivory. Dark and romantic, in the style of a grunge-inspired knitwear lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The lace yoke and tulle hem are the signature layers.
- Add 'full-length' to show the boots.
tryThis: Try this: Use full-length framing to include the boots.
